name: taiex-drawdown-atlas
description: TAIEX correction-wave analysis with turnover, foreign flow and margin-balance overlays

comments.devDependencies: Only tests/render.test.js needs these — it executes index.html in a headless DOM. The dashboard itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies; it loads ECharts from a CDN and opens straight from the filesystem. Without these installed the render suite reports SKIP and everything else still runs.
